name: Tomioka Tsuyoshi
source:
The original creator of Magical Schoolgirl Lilica and the current president of major video game publisher Kaguya Games.
Beginning with the smash-hit success of the shooter Magical Schoolgirl Lilica, which he conceived, he expanded the property into a television anime series and merchandise, rapidly transforming Kaguya Games into a major company.
His achievements are widely recognized both as a game planner and as a business executive.
He has supported the up-and-coming [url=/c156948]Shinjo[/url] and [url=/c157621]Takazawa[/url] ever since the founding of Shirosawa Games, and he also has high expectations for AKIBA LOST.

[From in-game profile]
